description: Work on lyrics — the web fallback (LRCLIB, Musixmatch, NetEase, Genius), the in-memory cache, verification, and embedding lyrics into audio file tags. Use this whenever a task touches `services/lyrics.py`, `services/tags.py`, the `/lyrics.json` route, or `scripts/embed_lyrics.py` / `embed_lyrics_cron.sh` — adding or fixing a provider, changing caching/verification, or the batch tagger. Covers the provider contract, the synced-vs-plain rule, the read-only cache, and why writes only ever store plain text.
